findings.summary: --backfill logic does not detect or fetch only missing weeks
findings.suggestion: The step brief (lines 75-76) explicitly specifies: 'compute which of those 4 weeks have no ShopSpendPulls coverage yet and request only the missing span'. However, the implementation unconditionally fetches all 4 weeks without checking Sheet coverage. The `missing_weeks_for_backfill()` function exists (line 48) and is tested, but is never called. To fix: (1) query the ShopSpendPulls tab to extract the set of covered weeks, (2) call `missing_weeks_for_backfill(candidates, covered)` to get the missing span, (3) pass only the missing weeks to the API. Without this, --backfill does not self-heal a Monday when the machine was off — it will redundantly re-fetch already-covered weeks every run.
